## What changed

Describe the behavior or documentation that changed.

## Why

Explain the user or contributor problem this solves.

## User impact

State what will be visibly different, or write `No user-facing change`.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage where applicable
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or setup changed

## Public repository safety

- [ ] No credentials, account IDs, private URLs, personal resource names, or internal material are included
- [ ] Provider-neutral behavior and documentation are preserved
- [ ] Remote execution remains behind explicit `--execute` approval
- [ ] Source export, redaction, lifecycle cleanup, and result verification remain fail-closed where applicable
